title: Particular Cases in Drafting
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a standard feature of all or of particular kinds of legislative instruments in your jurisdiction."
Note down whether section notes are a standard feature of all or of particular kinds of legislative instruments in your jurisdiction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one between several countries."
A multilateral treaty is the one between several countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used here solely to create vicarious liability."
The highlighted words are used here solely to create vicarious liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the mental element required to be proved by the definition of the crime."
Mens rea refers to the mental element required to be proved by the definition of the crime.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first drafting task given to most Legislative Counsel."
Drafting subsidiary legislation is the first drafting task given to most Legislative Counsel.
fib: ______ is a vital part of treaty negotiation process.
Preparation is a vital part of treaty negotiation process.
______ are the most common form of delegated legislation, these are made by the executive or a Minister to apply to the general population.
Regulations are the most common form of delegated legislation, these are made by the executive or a Minister to apply to the general population.
______ are a title, authorising words, definitions, formal sectioning and section notes and explanatory notes.
Typical exclusions are a title, authorising words, definitions, formal sectioning and section notes and explanatory notes.
______ means proclamation, regulations, rules, rules of court, bye-laws, order, notice or other instrument made under a written law and having legislative effect.
Subsidiary legislation means proclamation, regulations, rules, rules of court, bye-laws, order, notice or other instrument made under a written law and having legislative effect.
______ is the principal mechanism used to prevent or control anti-social behaviour and unacceptable activities.
The criminal law is the principal mechanism used to prevent or control anti-social behaviour and unacceptable activities.
